title: DLWP/1 ERROR body
description: Body of an ERROR (0xF0) frame. See RFC-0001 section 6. A fatal error must be followed by SESSION_END and the sender must close the connection.

code.description: Symbolic error code from the RFC-0001 section 6.2 registry.

message.description: Human-readable explanation in English. Must not contain stack traces, file contents, secrets or device identifiers.

severity.description: warning: informational, session continues. recoverable: only the affected operation or channel fails. fatal: must be followed by SESSION_END and the connection must be closed.

request_type.description: Message type of the frame that failed.

request_seq.description: Sequence number of the frame that failed.

details.description: Structured, capability-specific detail. For ERR_NOT_ALLOWED the key 'reason' carries deny_listed, not_in_allow_list, argument_rejected or denied_by_operator.
